name: SearchVesa
author: metamateplungin

sections.description:
SearchVesa makes SEO simple. Open any post or page and you see a clear score, a checklist of what to improve, and easy fields for your SEO title, meta description and URL slug. Preview exactly how your page will look on Google, Facebook and Twitter before you publish. It is free, works on your own site, and needs no account, sign-up or API key.

What you get, free

  • SEO score dashboard: an overall, readability and SEO score with a simple pass / warning / error checklist
  • Write your own SEO title, meta description, focus keyword and URL slug
  • Google search (SERP) preview, desktop and mobile
  • Facebook (Open Graph) and Twitter Card fields with live previews
  • Missing image alt-text scan, so you can add alt text in seconds
  • No account, no licence key, no external calls

Want it fixed for you?

SearchVesa shows you what to improve. If you would rather have it done for you, MetaMate is a separate paid plugin that adds one-click Auto-Fix (it rewrites your title and content and sets your focus keyword and meta description), AI-written titles, descriptions and alt text, and AI internal linking and schema markup. Where those features would be, SearchVesa shows a greyed-out button that links to the MetaMate page. This free plugin never calls any AI service itself, and it does not need MetaMate for anything listed above.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the searchvesa folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Open any post or page editor — the SearchVesa meta box appears below the content editor.
  4. Type your SEO title and meta description directly into the fields, set a focus keyword, and click “Analyze Content” to see your SEO & readability score.
sections.faq:
Do I need to know anything about SEO?

No. SearchVesa gives every post a score and a checklist of what to improve, in plain language. You choose what your page is about and write the words. If you would rather not write them yourself, MetaMate can do that for you.

Do I need an account to use SearchVesa?

No. Every feature in this plugin works without any account, sign-up, license key, or external API call of any kind.

Does this plugin send any of my content to an external service?

No. This plugin makes no outbound API calls at all — everything runs locally in your browser and on your own server. (MetaMate Premium, a separate plugin, does call an AI service for its AI-generation features; see that plugin’s own documentation.)

Can I manually type my own SEO title and meta description?

Yes — every field is fully editable by hand, with no limits.

What are the greyed-out “AI Suggest” buttons?

They show where MetaMate Premium’s AI-generated title/description/slug suggestions would appear. Clicking one opens the MetaMate Premium page in a new tab; nothing is sent anywhere and no data leaves your site.

What data does SearchVesa store on my site?

Your focus keyword, SEO title, meta description, and Open Graph/Twitter Card fields are stored as post meta on the relevant post. Nothing is stored outside of your own WordPress database.

What happens if I upgrade to MetaMate Premium later?

MetaMate Premium is a separate plugin with its own settings and its own SEO fields, so the titles, descriptions, and social settings you entered in SearchVesa do not carry over — you would enter them again in Premium. Running both plugins at once isn’t supported, and MetaMate Premium switches SearchVesa off when it is active.
